- Q2 2026 (8-K Aug 4, 2026): revenue $11.5B, GAAP diluted EPS $1.38 (NI $2,297M, 1,659M diluted shares), non-GAAP EPS $1.66. GAAP included $483M gains on long-term investments (other income $598M) and a $17M legal loss contingency. Amortization of acquired intangibles $544M, SBC $503M.
- Q1 2026 (8-K): revenue $10.3B, GAAP EPS $0.84 (NI $1,383M, 1,650M shares), non-GAAP EPS $1.37; amortization $551M, SBC $487M. Non-GAAP minus GAAP gap $0.53.
- Q2's gap was $0.28, but $0.29/share pre-tax came from investment gains, so the ex-gain gap is ~$0.53-0.57.
- Q3 2026 guidance (Aug 4): revenue ~$13.0B ±$0.3B (+13% q/q, +41% y/y), non-GAAP GM ~56%, non-GAAP opex ~$3.65B, non-GAAP tax 13%. Simple arithmetic gives non-GAAP EPS of about $1.91 at the midpoint.
- Consensus non-GAAP EPS: MarketBeat $1.94 on $13.06B revenue; Zacks/Barchart ~$1.67-1.68 (possibly stale). AMD beat consensus EPS in 5 of the last 8 quarters.
- 10-Q (Q2): long-term investments are mainly previously non-marketable equity that went public in Q2. $425M net unrealized gains; $1.1B fair value of marketable equity with sale restrictions through Oct 2028. Holdings are marked to market through GAAP other income each quarter. Up to $5.0B of investment commitments (reportedly including Anthropic).
- AMD Ventures took part in the Cerebras IPO (May 2026). CBRS closed $181.59 on Jun 26, 2026 and $206.75 on Sep 25, 2026 (+~14% over AMD's fiscal Q3). AMD's stake size is not disclosed.
- Year-ago Q3 2025 GAAP EPS was $0.75. FY2025 had ~$440M of net MI308 export-control charges, which is precedent for large one-off GAAP charges.
- Searched for but not found: any Q3 pre-announcement, impairment or restructuring announcement, AMD's exact list of public equity holdings, and a GAAP EPS consensus.
- Markets: none found on Polymarket or Manifold (harness search); Kalshi and bookmakers were not separately checked.
